about.title: Sergi Cebrian Pujol
about.subtitle: Over two decades of archery mastery, guiding dedicated athletes toward national and international success.
about.bioLead: Active competitive archer and accredited coach certified by the Royal Spanish Archery Federation (RFETA) and the Catalan Archery Federation (FCTA).
about.bioP1: La Cova del Drac was born from the ambition to provide a world-class training environment merging rigorous biomechanics, elite sports psychology, and specialized custom bow craftsmanship.
about.bioP2: Throughout his career, Sergi has claimed multiple podiums in national and regional championships in barebow, recurve, and 3D field archery, pairing competition experience with a passionate coaching vocation that has led youth archers to national squad call-ups.

about.quote: The arrow never lies. Every single shot is an honest mirror of your mind, your rhythm, and your inner calm.

methodology.title: Our Methodology
methodology.subtitle: A holistic coaching philosophy rooted in biomechanical repeatability, mental resilience, and athlete personalization.

pillars.title: Consistency
pillars.subtitle: Repeatability & Muscle Memory
pillars.description: We build an unshakeable, reproducible shot sequence, eliminating parasitic motion so anchor point and release remain identical under extreme pressure.

pillars.title: Focus
pillars.subtitle: Visual & Attentional Control
pillars.description: We train target lock, breath pacing, and the ability to silence external distractions whether on the shooting line or in the staging area.

pillars.title: Respect
pillars.subtitle: Ethics, Sportsmanship & Safety
pillars.description: Deep respect for equipment, squad mates, opponents, and match officials. Safety is the uncompromising baseline across all facilities.

pillars.title: Self-awareness
pillars.subtitle: Proprioception & Heart Rate Regulation
pillars.description: Archers learn to feel precise scapular loading, regulate heartbeat during crucial moments, and channel competition adrenaline into pinpoint execution.

blocks.title: Biomechanics & Skeletal Posture
blocks.description: Bone alignment, lower-body grounding, bow hand pressure point, and shoulder geometry tailored to each archer's morphology.

blocks.title: Match Tactics & Wind Clock Management
blocks.description: Head-to-head elimination strategy, wind gust compensation, and pacing within the strict 20 or 40-second shot clocks.

blocks.title: Mental Fortitude & Shoot-Off Pressure
blocks.description: Pre-shot mental routines, positive target visualization, and emotional centering for high-stakes single-arrow shoot-offs.

blocks.title: Equipment Tuning & Spine Optimization
blocks.description: Paper tuning, walk-back tests, bare-shaft grouping, dynamic arrow spine balancing, and handcrafted high-performance bowstrings.

facilities.title: High-Performance Facilities
facilities.subtitle: Engineered specifically for elite precision, technical safety, and continuous athletic progression across all distances.

lanes.title: High-Precision Indoor Hall
lanes.description: Official FITA indoor competition range. High-CRI 95 glare-free shadowless LED lighting, acoustic treatment, and reinforced Kevlar safety backstop.
specs: Instant replay monitors at the shooting line

lanes.title: Technical Mid-Range Line
lanes.description: Dedicated lane for indoor-to-outdoor transitions, sight calibration, arrow flight stability tests, and progressive archer development.
specs: Postural feedback mirrors on the line

lanes.title: Compound & Barebow Range
lanes.description: Official World Archery distance range for Compound 50m matches and national outdoor Barebow competition training.
specs: High-speed arrow stopping backstops (up to 340 fps)

lanes.title: Olympic Recurve Field
lanes.description: The official Olympic distance for Recurve archery. Full outdoor simulation with wind management, elevation, and tournament line protocols.
specs: Elevated platform for coach perspective & filming

zones.title: Master Bow Workshop & String Building
zones.description: String stretching jig, digital arrow spine testers, heavy-duty compound bow press, and dedicated paper tuning chamber for micron-level setup.

zones.title: Biomechanical Video Lab at 240 fps
zones.description: Multi-angle ultra-high-speed cameras analyzing clicker expansion, finger release purity, stabilizer harmonics, and arrow clearing dynamics.

zones.title: Scapular Warm-Up & Physical Conditioning
zones.description: Training zone equipped with variable resistance bands, bow simulators, stretching benches, and rotator cuff injury prevention gear.

facilities.accessInfoText: By appointment only. Private 1-on-1 coaching or small groups capped at 4 archers to guarantee 100% individual oversight. Smart card entry for accredited federated members.
